acceptanceCriteria: internal/testrunner/platform/README.md (or fixture helper) documents the package-identity collision and fixtures avoid it.
A test or check prevents a qualification fixture package from using a reserved toolchain module identity.
body: Found by the V1-0594 platform runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1000, head 111cfbebc, 2026-10-17; macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Swift 6.4, Xcode 27.0). A fixture package in a directory named `swift-testing` gets SwiftPM package identity swift_testing, which collides with the toolchain's Testing module, so the build fails before any test runs. This is a fixture/authoring hazard that can masquerade as an adapter build-error witness. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/swift-testing/build-error-package-identity. Expected: fixture generators and docs avoid such names (or the profile README warns), and build-error witnesses use an intentional compile error.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1392); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 1aa921aaaf4ab7f0867749f3710f7f6fef1f48c30525539497a9bd1770fef764.

title: swift-testing fixtures: a SwiftPM package directory named swift-testing gets identity swift_testing and collides with the SDK Testing module
